>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/rest/api/conversation/list-by-contact-uuid"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns the active conversations of one contact, each with its first and last
message, its queue and its assigned agent.

Identify the contact by `uuid` or by `mobile` — at least one of the two is required.

Note this operation is served from `https://e18.moobidesk.com`, not the
`api18` host used by the other operations in this API.
